description: ORION Academic Literature Review RAG Benchmark v2.2.0 — Extended with 10 varied cross-paper synthesis questions, 3 asymmetric cross-paper questions (one paper lacking evidence), 10 single-paper questions over full library, and audit note on heldout_cross_01.

audit_changelog.change: Updated page_number from 1 to 6, and updated exact_passage to reflect Section 'Production, fabrication, and manufacturing' in Emami.pdf.
audit_changelog.rationale: Plastic production of 19.3 Mt and polymer breakdowns (PE 22%) are in Section 3 / Table on physical Page 6 of Emami.pdf, not on Page 1.

audit_changelog.change: Added physical page 7 evidence alongside page 1 for Rita Garcia.pdf RIR (11%).
audit_changelog.rationale: While the abstract on page 1 states 11%, the formal equation and calculation are on Page 3 (Section 2.1.2) and Results on Page 7 (Section 3.2).

audit_changelog.change: Updated page_number from 1 to 2 in Haruhisa Yamamoto.pdf.
audit_changelog.rationale: The explicit enumeration of all 8 polymer types (LDPE, HDPE, PP, PS, PVC, PET, PUR, EPS) is in Section 2.2 on Page 2 (Chunk 32), while Page 1 abstract only mentions 'eight types' without naming them.

audit_changelog.change: Updated page_number from 4 to 9 in Saurabh Shukla.pdf and corrected factual targets to 9% recycled, 19% incinerated, and ~50% in landfills.
audit_changelog.rationale: Page 4 did not contain the global fate statistics; Chunk 77 on Page 9 explicitly states 'only 9% of plastic waste is recycled globally, while 19% is incinerated and ~ 50% ends up in landfills'.

audit_changelog.change: Replaced duplicate fact_01 passage with actual waste collection vs formal recycling assessment on physical Pages 8 and 3 in Emami.pdf.
audit_changelog.rationale: Emami et al. discusses the 13% (2 Mt) formal recycling rate on Page 8 (Chunk 82) and 60-70% putative estimates on Page 3 (Chunks 26-28).

audit_changelog.change: Added Page 1 alongside Page 6 for Somantri et al.
audit_changelog.rationale: The transaction breakdown (18 categories total, 9 purchase transactions totaling 27,028,801 kg) is in the Abstract on Page 1 (Chunk 3) as well as Page 5/6.

audit_changelog.change: Updated exact_passage to reflect Section 2 (Page 2, Chunk 21) on transaction-based traceability in Indonesia.
audit_changelog.rationale: Chunk 21 on Page 2 directly articulates the research gap in sales and purchase data-driven traceability.

audit_changelog.change: Added Page 7 to ground truth evidence for Yamamoto et al.
audit_changelog.rationale: Detailed packaging waste stream inflows (534 kt, 77% collection share) appear in Section 3 / Figure 4 on Page 7.

audit_changelog.change: Added 23 new verified benchmark samples (10 cross-paper, 3 asymmetric cross-paper, 10 single-paper over full library). Flagged heldout_cross_01 as not held-out.
audit_changelog.rationale: Comprehensive evaluation of cross-paper synthesis, asymmetric retrieval handling, and full-library single-paper precision.
